data.situation:
On Wednesday, 8 September, at half past one, Lin and Maya left the window table and followed a sign to the next aisle. The literature shelf held novels, poems and plays. A slim book on the fiction shelf caught Maya’s eye. Its cover showed one lamp burning in an otherwise dark station. The author, Ellen Rowe, was a novelist whose early books portrayed ordinary families living in unfamiliar places. This collection included “The Last Lamp”, a sci-fi story about a girl keeping a station light on while waiting for a visitor on a distant moon. Lin had expected a book full of machines, but the first page was about an empty chair. She turned back to the shelf label to check the genre, then wrote the story’s title on their selection sheet. ELLEN ROWE — FICTION
The Last Lamp and Other Stories
Genre: sci-fi
In the title story, a young girl keeps the final lamp burning after the last train departs. This collection was selected for the library’s September reading group. Borrow the book at the desk and return it after the discussion. A biography of the author and her autobiography are on the adjacent shelf.

readingBlocks.zh: 9月8日星期三，下午一点半，林和玛雅离开窗边桌，沿标牌走到下一排书架。文学作品架上放着小说、诗歌和剧本。小说架上一本薄书吸引了玛雅：封面是一座暗下来的车站，只有一盏灯还亮着。作者埃伦·罗是一位小说家，她早期的书描写了普通家庭在陌生地方生活的情景。这本集子里有一篇科幻短篇《最后一盏灯》，讲一个女孩在遥远的一颗卫星上为等来客，一直让车站的灯亮着。林原以为书里会满是机器，第一页写的却是一把空椅子。她翻回书架标签，确认作品类型，然后把短篇的名字写在选书单上。

readingBlocks.zh:
埃伦·罗——小说
《最后一盏灯及其他故事》
类型：科幻
在同名短篇里，最后一班列车开走后，一个小女孩仍让最后一盏灯亮着。这本集子入选了图书馆九月读书会。请到服务台办理借阅，在讨论结束后归还。作者的传记和她本人写的自传放在相邻书架上。

glossary.note: literature此处为具有文学价值的文字作品集合，包括架上的小说、诗歌和剧本；不泛指某专业领域资料或研究文献。
glossary.example: The literature shelf held novels, poems and plays.
glossary.exampleZh: 文学作品架上放着小说、诗歌和剧本。

externalEvidence.definition: creative writing of recognized artistic value

glossary.zh: 虚构文学作品；小说类作品
glossary.note: 通常不可数；fiction此处为小说架分类，不等于现实中的谎言或虚假陈述。
glossary.example: A slim book on the fiction shelf caught Maya’s eye.
glossary.exampleZh: 小说架上一本薄书吸引了玛雅。

externalEvidence.definition: a literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact

glossary.note: sci-fi是science fiction的常用简称；并非所有科幻都以机器介绍为主。
glossary.example: This collection included “The Last Lamp”, a sci-fi story about a girl keeping a station light on while waiting for a visitor on a distant moon.
glossary.exampleZh: 这本集子里有科幻短篇《最后一盏灯》，写女孩在遥远月球上为等来客，让车站的灯一直亮着。

externalEvidence.definition: literary fantasy involving the imagined impact of science on society

glossary.note: 人物名词；作者可同时写小说和短篇，本句明确她写过小说，不仅凭一个短篇称novelist。
glossary.example: The author, Ellen Rowe, was a novelist whose early books portrayed ordinary families living in unfamiliar places.
glossary.exampleZh: 作者埃伦·罗是一位小说家，她早期的书描写了普通家庭在陌生地方生活的情景。

glossary.note: 可数genre按形式/内容类型分类，本例sci-fi；原题材译保留，教学类型含义独立说明。
glossary.example: She turned back to the shelf label to check the genre, then wrote the story’s title on their selection sheet.
glossary.exampleZh: 她转回去查看书架标签，确认作品类型，然后把短篇的名字写在选书单上。

externalEvidence.definition: a kind of literary or artistic work
